title: polystichum trapezoides
intro: Polystichum trapezoides, commonly known as the Fan-leaved Lady fern, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum trapezoides are attributed to its ability to inhibit the growth of certain microorganisms, making it a potential treatment for infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
